queries.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.SNOWCANVAS_DECKS (ID STRING, TITLE STRING, PROMPT STRING, SPEC VARIANT, SLIDES INT, CREATED_BY STRING, CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.SNOWCANVAS_AUDIO (DECK_ID STRING, SLIDE INT, CHUNK INT, VOICE INT, MP3_B64 STRING, CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())

SELECT d.ID, d.TITLE, d.PROMPT, d.SLIDES, d.CREATED_AT, d.SPEC:subtitle::STRING AS SUB,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.SNOWCANVAS_AUDIO a WHERE a.DECK_ID = d.ID) AS AUDIO
       FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.SNOWCANVAS_DECKS d ORDER BY d.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 24
